item.title: Which Agency Workflow Should You Automate First?
item.description: Probably not the one that looked best in the demo. Score last week's recurring work on five questions, and start where the work is frequent, written down and cheap to get wrong.

item.title: Jev Can't Write a Sentence. That's Why Agencies Should Pay Attention.

item.title: Every Platform Grades Its Own Homework. Here's How to Check It.
